body_markdown:
The Middleby Corporation (NASDAQ: MIDD), a global leader in commercial foodservice solutions, today reported net earnings for the third quarter of 2026.


Tim FitzGerald, CEO of the Middleby Corporation said, “We delivered record third quarter net sales and strong organic growth across our commercial foodservice business. Adjusted EBITDA increased 10% from the prior year, and our performance exceeded the high end of our guidance ranges for net sales, Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EPS. These results reflect the benefits of our strategic investments, industry-leading innovation and continued focus on customer-driven solutions.”


Tim FitzGerald continued, “Following the successful separation of our Food Processing business and the launch of Midera as an independent public company, Middleby is now a focused, pure-play commercial foodservice leader. We remain committed to disciplined capital allocation and repurchased 1.0 million shares during the third quarter and 4.8 million shares year to date. Our strong third quarter performance and continued business momentum give us confidence to raise our full year 2026 guidance.”


Please refer to the attached PDF for more financial information.
